name: orthfilt
expr: [L2D, H2D, L2R, H2R] = orthfilt(W2); [L4D, H4D, L4R, H4R] = orthfilt(W4); [LcD, HcD, LcR, HcR] = orthfilt(Wcst);
comment: Sig: [Lo_D, Hi_D, Lo_R, Hi_R] = orthfilt(W). Quadruple from a unit-norm scaling filter W (sum(W)=1, length even). Lo_R = W·√2; Lo_D = reverse(Lo_R); Hi_R[k] = (-1)^k · Lo_R[N-1-k]; Hi_D = reverse(Hi_R). Coverage: db2 (4-tap), db4 (8-tap), custom 2-tap.
